subject: Copywriting
title: Features Tell, Benefits Sell
description: A quick win: understand Features Tell, Benefits Sell.

hook.text: 'This drill has a 1/4-inch bit' is a feature. 'This drill makes a 1/4-inch hole' is a benefit.

buildup.text: Features describe the product. Benefits describe what the product does for the reader. Sales letters sell benefits.

discovery.text: Apple says 'thousands of songs in your pocket,' not '5GB hard drive.' The benefit is emotional; the feature is.

twist.text: Some audiences want features: engineers, developers, and technical buyers. Know when to lead with specs vs outcomes.

climax.text: The master technique: state the feature, then immediately translate it into a benefit.

punchline.text: People buy holes, not drills. Translate every feature into a benefit.

quiz.question: What is the difference between a feature and a benefit?
options: Features cost money; benefits are free
Features describe the product; benefits describe what it does for the reader
